{{short description|Hungarian mathematician}}
'''Bálint Tóth''' (born 1955, [[Cluj-Napoca|Cluj/Kolozsvár/Klausenburg]]) is a [[Hungary|Hungarian]] mathematician whose work concerns [[probability theory]], [[stochastic process]] and probabilistic aspects of [[mathematical physics]]. He obtained PhD in 1988 from the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]], worked as senior researcher at the [[Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics|Institute of Mathematics]] of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences|HAS]] and as professor of mathematics at [[Budapest University of Technology and Economics|TU Budapest]]. He holds the Chair of Probability at the [[University of Bristol]] and is a research professor at the [[Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics]], Budapest.

He has worked on microscopic models of [[Brownian motion]], quantum spin systems, limit theorems for [[random walk]]s with long memory, and non-conventional [[stochastic process]]es, hydrodynamic limits, etc.  In particular, Tóth contributed to the theory of self-interacting motions, that is, motions that are "reinforced", "self-avoiding" or "self-repellent". In collaboration with [[Wendelin Werner]] he constructed<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Tóth|first1=Bálint|last2=Werner|first2=Wendelin|date=1998-07-01|title=The true self-repelling motion|journal=Probability Theory and Related Fields|language=en|volume=111|issue=3|pages=375–452|doi=10.1007/s004400050172|s2cid=124009479|issn=1432-2064|doi-access=free}}</ref> the random geometric object later called the [[Brownian web]].

Tóth was an [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker]] of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] ICM-2018 (Rio de Janeiro),<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=ICM 2018 Rio de Janeiro|url=https://icm2018.impa.br/portal/main.html|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200904060801/https://icm2018.impa.br/portal/main.html |archive-date=2020-09-04 |access-date=|website=}}</ref> and of the [[European Congress of Mathematics]] ECM-2000 (Barcelona). He was plenary speaker at three Conferences on Stochastic Processes and their Applications SPA-2005 (Santa Barbara),<ref>{{Cite web|title=30th Conference on Stochastic Processes and their Applications {{!}} Department of Statistics and Applied Probability - UC Santa Barbara|url=https://www.pstat.ucsb.edu/news/feature/1020|access-date=2021-01-12|website=www.pstat.ucsb.edu}}</ref> SPA-2014 (Buenos Aires),<ref>{{Cite web|title=SPA-2014 - 37th Conference on Stochastic Processes and their Applications|url=http://mate.dm.uba.ar/~probab/spa2014/|access-date=2021-01-12|website=mate.dm.uba.ar}}</ref> and IMS Medallion Lecturer<ref>{{Cite web|title=IMS Lecturers in 2022|url=https://imstat.org/2021/12/15/ims-lecturers-in-2022/}}</ref> at SPA-2022 (Wuhan).<ref>{{Cite web|title=SPA-2022 - 42nd Conference on Stochastic Processes and their Applications|url=http://spa2022.whu.edu.cn/Programme/Plenary_talks.htm}}</ref>

He is a member of [[Academia Europaea]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Academy of Europe: Tóth Bálint|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/T%C3%B3th_B%C3%A1lint|access-date=2021-01-12|website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref> and a corresponding member of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Hungarian Academy of Sciences: Tóth Bálint|url=https://mta.hu/koztestuleti_tagok?PersonId=12043}}</ref>

Tóth was Editor-in-Chief of the journals [[Electronic Journal of Probability]] (2009-2011)<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Past Editors of IMS Publications|url=https://imstat.org/past-editors-of-ims-journals/|access-date=2021-01-12|language=en}}</ref> and [[Annals of Applied Probability]] (2016-2018).<ref name=":0" /> Currently he is co-Editor-in-Chief (jointly with [[Fabio Toninelli]]) of [[Probability Theory and Related Fields]].<ref>{{cite web
| title = Probability Theory and Related Fields editors
| url = https://link.springer.com/journal/440/editors
| access-date = 15 March 2024
| url-status = live
| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20240315093717/https://link.springer.com/journal/440/editors
| archive-date = 15 March 2024}}</ref>
